title: Throne and Shadow - Court Intrigue Music Pack, Medieval Kingdom Orchestral BGM - 44 Tracks
tagline: 44 track court intrigue score: eight scenes in the hall and in the shadow, minute long loops, a harp in every track.
description:
Throne and Shadow is a 44 track court intrigue music pack for kingdom, management, strategy and RPG games: 38 full looping pieces and 6 short cues, 57:54 of music, as OGG files with sample accurate loop tags plus all 44 editable MIDI sources. RPG Maker MV and MZ read the loop points with no plugin, and the Readme gives the import steps for Godot 4 (followed in a blank Godot 4.7.2 project, all 44 files), Unity and GameMaker. Royalty free for commercial games. Three full tracks are free to download on this page, with their MIDI.

One reign from the throne room to the coronation. The court: "Throne and Shadow", "The Throne Room", "The Empty Throne", "The Great Hall", "The Council Chamber", "The Closed Session", "The Envoy Arrives", "Negotiation", "The Treasury", "The Archive" and "Petition Day". Its rooms and its people: "The Royal Garden", "The Garden at Night", "The Banquet", "The Poisoned Cup", "The Chapel Royal", "The Confessor", "The Masque", "The Tournament", "The Queen's Theme", "The Queen Alone", "The Market Below the Walls", "The Heir" and "The Heir in Exile". The plot: "The Spymaster", "Letters in Cipher", "The Corridors", "Riders at the Gate", "Betrayal", "The Trial", "Exile" and "The Dungeon Beneath". The succession: "The Old King's Death", "The Regent", "The Coronation", "The Usurper's Crown", "Long Live the Queen" and "Throne and Shadow (Credits)". Cues: "Royal Fanfare", "By Decree", "The Scheme Succeeds", "Plot Discovered", "Disgrace" and "A New Reign".

The hall and the shadow. Eight scenes come twice: "The Throne Room" and "The Empty Throne" (80 and 66 BPM); "The Council Chamber" and "The Closed Session" (88 and 76 BPM); "The Royal Garden" and "The Garden at Night" (84 and 70 BPM); "The Banquet" and "The Poisoned Cup" (100 and 84 BPM); "The Chapel Royal" and "The Confessor" (66 and 58 BPM); "The Queen's Theme" and "The Queen Alone" (76 and 62 BPM); "The Heir" and "The Heir in Exile" (88 and 72 BPM); "The Coronation" and "The Usurper's Crown" (72 and 64 BPM). In each pair the shadow's lead is the hall's note for note, the same pitches and the same rhythm in the same key (879 lead notes across the eight pairs, measured in the shipped MIDI), and every chord under it is moved down a third, which keeps two of its three notes (76 of 76 chords). The shadow is always the slower of the two. No other full piece shares a hall's lead (0 of 288 comparisons). Use the hall for the scene as the court sees it, and the shadow for the same room once the plot is under way.

Loops of a minute. Court and strategy games stay on one screen for a long time, so all 38 full pieces loop for at least a minute before they repeat: the shortest loop is 62.5 seconds, read from the LOOPLENGTH tag of the shipped OGG files. 6 of the faster pieces carry a third section to stay over the minute.

One theme, one harp. The seed theme, The Crown, rises a fifth, steps back twice and climbs a third, and all 44 tracks state it in its own shape, counted by the harness in the finished MIDI. Four more themes come with it: The Usurper is the seed turned over, for the riders, the betrayal, the trial and exile; The Council moves in even quarters and a turn of eighths, for the council, the treasury and the banquet; The Oath opens on a held half note and climbs, for the envoy, the chapel and the heir; The Whisper creeps in four eighths and falls, for the archive, the spymaster and the cipher. The harp plays in all 44 tracks, 1802 notes: the counter line in 33 of them, the pad in 9 and a colour part in 2. 1,932 statements and fragments of the 5 themes across the album.

What is in it. 38 full pieces and 6 cues, 57:54 of music, 15 in ionian, 12 in aeolian, 6 in dorian, 4 in phrygian, 4 in lydian and 3 in mixolydian, 30 keys, 58 to 120 BPM, all in 4/4. 29 General MIDI instruments: piano, harpsichord, celesta, dulcimer, reed organ, nylon guitar, acoustic bass, violin, viola, cello, contrabass, tremolo strings, harp, timpani, strings, slow strings, choir, voice oohs, trumpet, trombone, tuba, French horn, brass section, oboe, English horn, bassoon, clarinet, flute and recorder. There is no drum kit and no synth; timpani (684 notes) are the only percussion. Every pitched note is in its track's mode: 18,351 notes read, none outside it.

What you get. 44 OGG files, 38 of them with sample accurate LOOPSTART and LOOPLENGTH tags, which is what RPG Maker MV and MZ read; each looping file ends exactly at its loop end. 44 editable .mid sources. A Readme with per engine import notes, the proof reports, and a royalty free commercial licence.

Gate results. 788 theory checks and 510 audio checks, 0 failed, and the reports ship inside the download. They say the music is correctly written, rendered and tagged. They are not a claim about taste, which is what the free tracks are for.

Three full tracks are free on this page, with their MIDI: "The Queen's Theme" and "The Queen Alone", one hall and its shadow (open the two MIDI files and compare the part named lead), and "Betrayal".

An honest note. The renders are a General MIDI reference render through a conventional soundfont, and the instruments are the General MIDI sounds of those names; the MIDI is there so you can use your own. No game cue or film cue is quoted; every tune was composed for this record. The composition system is AI written code and no generative audio model is used anywhere.

devlog.title: Throne and Shadow is out: a 44 track court intrigue score with eight scenes written twice
devlog.body:
Throne and Shadow is a 44 track music pack for kingdom, management, strategy and RPG games: one reign from the throne room to the coronation, with the council, the envoy, the treasury, the banquet, the spymaster, the masque, the trial, exile, the old king's death, the regent and the succession, plus six short cues. It is live now, with three full tracks free to download from the page.

The idea. Eight scenes come twice, in the hall and in the shadow. The shadow keeps the hall's lead note for note (879 lead notes across the eight pairs, measured in the shipped MIDI) and moves every chord under it down a third (76 of 76), at a slower tempo, so one room can be played as the court sees it and again once the plot is under way. All 38 full pieces loop for a minute or more (shortest 62.5 seconds), the harp plays in all 44 tracks, and the seed theme is stated in its own shape in all 44.

How it was checked. 788 theory checks and 510 audio checks, 0 failed, with the reports inside the download. The loop tags were followed into a blank Godot 4.7.2 project, all 44 files. Those numbers say the music is correctly written, rendered and tagged. They are not a claim about taste, which is what the free tracks ("The Queen's Theme", "The Queen Alone" and "Betrayal") are for.

The renders are a General MIDI reference render; the MIDI is there so you can move it to your own sounds. No game cue or film cue is quoted. The composition system is AI written code and no generative audio model is used.
